record.bible_text: The word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> which came to Jeremiah<WH03414> the prophet<WH05030> against the Gentiles<WH01471>;

<FI> As<Fi> I live<WH02416>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the King<WH04428>, whose name<WH08034> <FI>is<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>, Surely as Tabor<WH08396> <FI>is<Fi> among the mountains<WH02022>, and as Carmel<WH03760> by the sea<WH03220>, <FI>so<Fi> shall he come<WH0935><WTH8799>.

O thou daughter<WH01323> dwelling<WH03427><WTH8802> in Egypt<WH04714>, furnish<WH06213><WTH8798> thyself to go into captivity<WH03627><WH01473>: for Noph<WH05297> shall be waste<WH08047> and desolate<WH03341><WTH8738> without an inhabitant<WH03427><WTH8802>. <RF>furnish...: Heb. make thee instruments of captivity<Rf>
